---
name: Skill feedback / Skill 反馈

## What happened? / 发生了什么？

Describe the actual behavior and what you expected. / 描述实际行为和预期。

## Context / 使用环境

- Harness and version / 工具与版本：
- Installation method / 安装方式：
- Request and document language / 请求与文档语言：

## Minimal example / 最小示例

Include the request and relevant response; remove private information.
提供请求与相关回复，请移除私有信息。

## Human and AI work / 人与 AI 的分工

What should the person have done? Were hints or implementation requested?
哪些工作原本应该由人完成？是否明确要求过提示或代写？
